title: Implement matter links, guarded merges, and reversible identity correction
summary: Provide independent relation and merge operations. Make identity mistakes recoverable, preserve conflicting children, and ensure a protected separation cannot be defeated by a later indirect merge.
out_of_scope: Deleting evidence to force a clean merge
implementation: Validate relationship type, scope, and cycle rules independently from equivalence.
Plan merges against the full revision set and record every move, retained conflict, and redirect.
Enforce protected undo/separation decisions across complete merged groups.
Restore partitions through explicit correction receipts and emit identity dependency changes.

acceptance.criterion: Related-to chains never become equivalence closures.
acceptance.verification: Create A-related-B-related-C and retain three identities.

acceptance.criterion: A merge preserves evidence, conflicts, redirects, and movement history.
acceptance.verification: Merge overlapping children and inspect all retained records.

acceptance.criterion: Correction cannot be silently undone by replay or indirect merging.
acceptance.verification: Run merge, undo/split, transitive remerge, and stale retry scenarios.

tests: Colliding child evidence remains retained and explained.
Historical assessment shows its former merged view.
Concurrent merges cannot create redirect cycles.
risks: Partial correction could restore IDs while leaving dependent references current.

reuse.application: Inspect merge_blocker and merge receipts, including protected undo, before neutral reimplementation.
